solvers.a: This is a constraint-based local search solver. This solver takes inspiration from Localizer, Comet, OscaR.cbls, Yuck, and Kangaroo.
solvers.b: This is an open-source MILP solver specializing in integer and linear optimization, widely used as a robust and lightweight alternative to commercial engines.
solvers.c: This is a Java-based constraint programming toolkit supporting finite domain constraints and offering customizable search strategies for discrete optimization.
solvers.d: A parallel configuration of Solver c that exploits multi-threaded search, improving runtimes on hard combinatorial problems while retaining its flexible Java modeling interface.
solvers.e: A solver c mode that integrates CP with SAT-style reasoning to handle complex and hybrid combinatorial models more efficiently in a free configuration.
solvers.f: A free, high-performance CP solver leveraging Lazy Clause Generation to combine SAT-like learning with traditional CP techniques, especially suited for rich scheduling and routing tasks.
solvers.g: This solver is a powerful constraint programming solver tailored for scheduling, planning, and sequencing, providing strong propagation and heuristic search.
solvers.h: This is a top-tier solver supporting LP, MILP, and QP, known for fast branch-and-bound, presolve, and cutting-plane methods; commonly used in academia.
solvers.i: A free (typically academic) solver, a leading commercial solver for LP, MILP, QP, and more, recognized for state-of-the-art performance, parallelization, and tuning tools.
solvers.j: An open-source suite for LP, MILP, and QP that includes simplex and interior-point methods; designed to be lightweight, modern, and easy to integrate into scientific workflows.
solvers.k: A free constraint programming solver supporting expressive modeling and modern search heuristics, positioned for practical combinatorial decision and scheduling tasks.
solvers.l: A free solver from the MiniZinc ecosystem that blends constraint and logic programming; supports expressive modeling and integrates cleanly with MiniZinc workflows.
solvers.m: An open-source Java CP solver providing advanced propagators and search heuristics, especially popular in education and prototyping of discrete decision models.
solvers.n: A free solver implementing CP-SAT, combining SAT learning with MILP-style reasoning to efficiently solve large-scale scheduling and routing models.
solvers.o: A variant of n with local-search and metaheuristic enhancements, suited for large or highly-structured combinatorial optimization models.
solvers.p: A free SAT/CP-hybrid solver integrated with a logic-based language, enabling concise modeling with logic, tabling, and pattern-based constructs for combinatorial tasks.
solvers.q: A free SAT and Max-SAT solver aimed at optimization-centric Boolean reasoning, providing clause learning and heuristics suitable for decision and cost-based models.
solvers.r: A free solver that unifies mixed-integer programming and constraint programming with nonlinear extensions; known for strong presolve, cutting planes, and flexibility.
solvers.s: A solver that blends Prolog with constraint logic programming capabilities, enabling expressive models for combinatorial reasoning and inference.
solvers.t: This is a FlatZinc interpreter that integrates with the MiniZinc toolchain. It combines local search with restarting, global constraints, and lexicographic cost functions.
